PC Errata 2017 disc card of [[Lieutenant Sheckil]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 22 April 2017. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/CloudCity-Dark/large/lieutenantsheckil.gif lieutenantsheckil.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170422003954/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/CloudCity-Dark/large/lieutenantsheckil.gif Internet Archive] (22 April 2017, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 25 September 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260925003534/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/CloudCity-Dark/large/lieutenantsheckil.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Lieutenant Sheckil (PC Errata 2017 disc card)]].
